newsitem.title: CHINA: French firm wins China water plant bid.
newsitem.headline: French firm wins China water plant bid.

text.p: The French water treatment company Degremort has won a bid for the design and construction of a water purifying plant in Hangzhou in east China's Zhejiang province, the official Xinhua news agency said on Thursday.
The French company's winning bid was 210.96 million yuan, the agency said. Work will begin within two months and the plant wil be finished by the end of the year, the agency said.
When the plant is completed, Hangzhou's daily water supply capacity will be increased to 1.6 million cubic metres, meeting the city's water supply needs, it added.
